build_starlette_app: build a Starlette app with gzip middleware and optional CORS for a Hugging Face inference pipeline
create_get_pipeline: create a cached function that reads TASK and MODEL_ID env vars and returns the matching pipeline instance
run_startup_event: run an async startup event that configures uvicorn logging and pre-initializes the inference pipeline
review_allowed_tasks: review the ALLOWED_TASKS dictionary mapping task names like text-classification to their pipeline classes
refactor_routes: refactor the Starlette routes to add new endpoints for the pipeline_route POST handler
